prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, stiffness, and muscle guarding. Examination findings were consistent with cervical and lumbar strain, and the reported mechanism of injury is well matched to the nature and force of the impact. Imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury and rule out fracture or instability. The patient has no known prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions. Care was delivered over fifteen visits and included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction, following a typical course of recovery. Pain and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated billing. The patient was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
